title.en: Claude Models & API Pricing: Fable 5.1, Opus, Sonnet and Haiku
title.zh: Claude 模型与 API 价格：Fable 5.1、Opus、Sonnet 和 Haiku

excerpt.en: Compare current Claude model pricing, Fable 5.1 cache rates, 1M context, Batch and Fast mode, tool charges, and data residency.
excerpt.zh: 对比当前 Claude 模型价格、Fable 5.1 缓存费率、100 万上下文、Batch、Fast mode、工具费用和数据驻留。

heading.zh: 当前 Claude 模型家族

en: Anthropic’s current core lineup spans four workload tiers. Claude Fable 5.1 is the highest-capability public model for difficult long-horizon agents, Opus 5 targets complex production coding and reasoning, Sonnet 5 balances speed and intelligence, and Haiku 4.5 prioritizes latency and cost.

This comparison uses Anthropic’s official model overview and pricing pages checked on September 3, 2026. Anthropic recommends that most workloads start with Opus 5 and move to Fable 5.1 only when Opus at high effort falls short.
zh: Anthropic 当前核心产品线覆盖四个工作负载档位：Claude Fable 5.1 面向高难度长任务 Agent，Opus 5 面向复杂生产编程和推理，Sonnet 5 平衡速度与智能，Haiku 4.5 则优先考虑延迟与成本。
本页使用 2026 年 9 月 3 日核验的 Anthropic 官方模型概览和价格页。Anthropic 建议大多数任务先使用 Opus 5；只有当 Opus high effort 仍无法胜任时，再切换到 Fable 5.1。

en: Claude API prices are quoted in USD per million tokens (MTok). Input and output are billed separately, and output tokens are materially more expensive across all four models.

Choose by workload rather than price alone: Fable for maximum broadly available capability, Opus for complex production agents, Sonnet for the general-purpose balance, and Haiku for high-volume execution.
zh: Claude API 以美元/百万 tokens（MTok）报价，输入和输出分别计费，四个模型的输出 token 都明显贵于输入。
模型选择不应只看价格：最高广泛可用能力选择 Fable，复杂生产智能体选择 Opus，通用平衡选择 Sonnet，高调用量执行选择 Haiku。

en: Sonnet 5 has used its standard $3 per MTok input and $15 per MTok output rates since September 1, 2026. The $2/$10 introductory offer ended August 31.
Current Sonnet 5 cache prices are $3.75 for a 5-minute write, $6 for a 1-hour write, and $0.30 for a cache read per MTok. New budgets should use these standard rates.
zh: Sonnet 5 已于 2026 年 9 月 1 日开始执行输入 $3/MTok、输出 $15/MTok 的标准价格，之前的 $2/$10 推广价于 8 月 31 日结束。
Sonnet 5 当前每百万 tokens 的缓存价格为：5 分钟写入 $3.75，1 小时写入 $6，缓存读取 $0.30。新预算应使用这些标准费率。

en: Anthropic separates cache creation from cache reads. For Fable 5.1, a 5-minute write costs $12.50 per MTok, a 1-hour write costs $20, and a cache read costs $0.25. Other Claude models use their own published cache rates.
Caching is valuable when long system instructions, documents, or examples repeat across requests. Calculate whether reuse is frequent enough to offset the initial write premium.
zh: Anthropic 将缓存创建与缓存读取分开计费。Fable 5.1 的 5 分钟写入为 $12.50/MTok，1 小时写入为 $20，缓存读取为 $0.25；其他 Claude 模型采用各自公布的缓存费率。
当长系统指令、文档或示例在多个请求中重复时，缓存很有价值。应计算复用频率是否足以覆盖首次写入的溢价。

heading.en: Context Windows, Batch and Fast Mode
heading.zh: 上下文窗口、Batch 与 Fast Mode

en: Fable 5.1, Opus 5 and Sonnet 5 include a full 1M-token context window at standard per-token rates and support 128K synchronous output. Haiku 4.5 supports 200K input and 64K output.

Batch API reduces both input and output prices by 50%. Fast mode is a research preview for Opus 5 and Opus 4.8 on the first-party Claude API; Opus 5 Fast mode costs $10 input and $50 output per MTok. Fast mode cannot be combined with Batch.
zh: Fable 5.1、Opus 5 和 Sonnet 5 以标准 token 单价包含完整 100 万上下文窗口，同步输出上限为 12.8 万；Haiku 4.5 支持 20 万输入和 6.4 万输出。
Batch API 的输入和输出价格均享受 50% 折扣。Fast mode 是 Opus 5 和 Opus 4.8 在第一方 Claude API 上的研究预览；Opus 5 Fast mode 输入 $10、输出 $50/MTok，且不能与 Batch 组合使用。

en: For Claude 4.6 and later, US-only inference selected through inference_geo applies a 1.1× multiplier to input, output, cache writes, and cache reads. Default global routing uses standard prices.

Web search costs $10 per 1,000 searches plus normal tokens. Web fetch has no separate tool fee, but fetched content becomes billable input. Code execution includes 1,550 free organization-hours per month and then costs $0.05 per container-hour when it is not free through eligible web search or fetch usage.
zh: Claude 4.6 及更高版本通过 inference_geo 选择仅限美国推理时，输入、输出、缓存写入和缓存读取统一应用 1.1 倍乘数；默认全球路由使用标准价格。
网络搜索每 1,000 次 $10，另计正常 token；Web fetch 没有单独工具费，但抓取内容会成为计费输入。代码执行每个组织每月包含 1,550 免费小时，在未通过符合条件的网络搜索或抓取免费使用时，超出部分按每容器小时 $0.05 收费。

heading.en: Claude Managed Agents and Cost Control
heading.zh: Claude Managed Agents 与成本控制

en: Claude Managed Agents bill model tokens at standard rates plus $0.08 per running session-hour. Idle, rescheduling, and terminated time is not billed as runtime. Batch, Fast mode, data-residency, and partner-cloud pricing modifiers do not apply to Managed Agents sessions.

For cost control, route simple work to Haiku, general production work to Sonnet, complex agents to Opus, and highest-capability workloads to Fable. Add prompt caching for repeated context and Batch for non-interactive jobs.
zh: Claude Managed Agents 按标准模型 token 价格计费，并额外按每个运行中的会话小时 $0.08 收取运行时间费用；idle、rescheduling 和 terminated 状态不计运行时费用。Batch、Fast mode、数据驻留和合作云平台价格修饰符不适用于 Managed Agents 会话。
控制成本时，可将简单任务路由给 Haiku，通用生产任务给 Sonnet，复杂智能体给 Opus，最高能力需求给 Fable；重复上下文使用提示缓存，非交互任务使用 Batch。

question.zh: 哪个 Claude 模型最便宜？

answer.en: Claude Haiku 4.5 is the lowest-cost current core model at $1 input and $5 output per MTok.
answer.zh: Claude Haiku 4.5 是当前核心模型中价格最低的版本，输入 $1、输出 $5/MTok。

answer.en: Sonnet 5 costs $3 per MTok input and $15 per MTok output. Its introductory offer ended August 31, 2026.
answer.zh: Sonnet 5 当前输入为 $3/MTok，输出为 $15/MTok；推广价已于 2026 年 8 月 31 日结束。

question.en: Do current Claude models support 1M context?
question.zh: 当前 Claude 模型都支持 1M 上下文吗？

answer.en: Fable 5.1, Opus 5 and Sonnet 5 do. Haiku 4.5 has a 200K context window.
answer.zh: Fable 5.1、Opus 5 和 Sonnet 5 支持 100 万；Haiku 4.5 的上下文窗口为 20 万。

question.en: Can prompt caching and Batch be combined?
question.zh: 提示缓存和 Batch 可以组合吗？

answer.en: Yes. Batch and prompt-caching discounts can be combined. Fast mode cannot be combined with Batch.
answer.zh: 可以，Batch 和提示缓存折扣能够组合；Fast mode 不能与 Batch 组合。
